Note that the text from the Handbook to the Lutheran Hymnal is available on Project Wittenberg, operated by the Walther Library of Concordia Theological Seminary Fort Wayne and the text is listed as public domain. https://www.projectwittenberg.org/etext/gerhardt_p/trial.txt Any changes by Brian Dumont are released to the public domain.
